title: Deadlock instead of crash when running out of object slots
body:
### Tested versions

Encountered on 4.6-dev1; I think this is a regression from when script backtraces were added. (But the correct behavior is to crash anyway, so don't worry about the regression breaking something in production.)

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev1 - Debian GNU/Linux forky/sid forky on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (RPL-P) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1360P (16 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory

### Issue description

If we run out of object slots:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8d8041bd4dab30e51ecf5be21dc7bf1f6a26c039/core/object/object.cpp#L2443

We call `_err_print_error` while the ObjectDB spin lock is held.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8d8041bd4dab30e51ecf5be21dc7bf1f6a26c039/core/error/error_macros.cpp#L117

`_err_print_error` calls `ScriptServer::capture_script_backtraces`...

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8d8041bd4dab30e51ecf5be21dc7bf1f6a26c039/core/object/script_language.cpp#L564

...which instantiates `ScriptBacktrace` objects (which we can't do anyway because we're out of object slots).

### Steps to reproduce

See above.
